name: Diving Gear
description: Several mods in the pack let you stay underwater.

pages.title: Diving Gear
pages.text: Several mods in the pack let you stay underwater. They differ in what they give you, so pick for the job: air, vision, speed, or a dry room.

pages.title: Copper Diving Helmet
pages.text: Gives Water Breathing while a worn Backtank has air. Create's own set.

pages.title: Copper Backtank
pages.text: Wear it for air. Placed and spun by rotation, it refills itself. Netherite gear lets you dive in lava.

pages.title: Reinforced Diving Helmet
pages.text: Hybrid Aquatic's suit also has Reinforced and Glowing versions.

pages.title: Diving Weight
pages.text: Sinks you faster. A Hybrid Aquatic item.

pages.title: Salvager Suit
pages.text: Full set supplies air and stops freezing in the Ice Maze.

pages.title: Seaglide
pages.text: Swim fast on your own hunger. Part of Deep Seas.

**Artifacts** adds a **Snorkel**, **Flippers** and **Aqua-Dashers** as wearable accessories, so they stack with armor. See [#](2E5AAC)[Artifacts](entry://exploration/gear)[#](). For rooms and ships that stay dry, use the oxygen setup in [#](2E5AAC)[Hulls and Pressure](entry://ocean/hulls_and_pressure)[#]().
